prompts.name: find_hotel
prompts.title: Find a comfortable hotel
prompts.description: Hotels in a destination ranked by comfort for what matters to you, with links that book your dates.

arguments.name: destination
arguments.description: City or island, e.g. Lisbon or Bali

arguments.name: what_matters
arguments.description: e.g. quiet nights, a great bed, fast WiFi, near the beach

arguments.name: budget
arguments.description: Highest price per night, e.g. US$150

arguments.name: dates
arguments.description: Check-in and check-out, e.g. 12 to 15 March 2027

prompts.name: plan_my_trip
prompts.title: Plan a multi-stop trip
prompts.description: One hotel per stop for a trip through several destinations, dated back to back, with an indicative total.

arguments.name: stops
arguments.description: Destinations and nights in order, e.g. Lisbon 4 nights, Porto 3, Madrid 5

arguments.name: travel_style
arguments.description: e.g. couples, families, remote work, deep sleep

arguments.name: budget
arguments.description: Highest price per night, e.g. US$200

prompts.name: compare_my_hotels
prompts.title: Compare hotels
prompts.description: Two to four hotels you're considering, side by side: comfort, what guests complain about, price and a verdict.

arguments.name: hotels
arguments.description: Hotel names, e.g. Pestana Palace, Memmo Alfama

prompts.name: choose_area
prompts.title: Choose where to stay
prompts.description: The best areas of a destination for comfort, with their prices and top hotels.

arguments.name: what_matters
arguments.description: e.g. quiet, walkable, near the beach, nightlife

resources.name: hotel_cards
resources.title: OKstays hotel cards
resources.description: Hotel cards with photo, Comfort Score, price and a link to the hotel's OKstays page.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.title: Search hotels
tools.description: Use this when the user wants hotels in a destination (e.g. 'quiet hotels in Bangkok under $150'), or asks about a hotel by name (hotel_name). Returns up to 10 hotels per page, ranked by the OKstays Comfort Score (0-10 from what guests report: Comfort & Essentials 60%, the five must-haves (cleanliness, beds, shower, bugs and safety) 30% and sleep and room 30%; Perks & Facilities 15%; Service & Hospitality 15%; Access & Convenience 10%; repeated complaints about any must-have keep a hotel out) or by a travel style's score (half the Comfort Score, half how well it fits the style), highest first (ties go to the hotel more guests reviewed), each with strengths, complaints, indicative price and its okstays.com link. Filters: travel style, signals the hotel must score 8+ on, price, minimum score, neighbourhood, distance from a point, and the kind of stay: property_type hotels (default), apartments, hostels or any (the long-stays persona defaults to any). Pass the user's dates and guests when known. Places to stay only, not flights or car hire. Read-only, no sign-in.

location.description: City name or slug, e.g. 'Barcelona' or 'new-york'. Use list_cities for coverage.

persona.description: Travel style to rank for: digital-nomad, deep-sleep, avoid-crowds, romantic, family, business, solo-safe, luxury, budget-comfort, long-stays.

property_type.description: property_type: hotels (default), apartments, hostels or any. hotels includes guest houses, B&Bs, aparthotels and resorts; apartments includes holiday homes, villas and homestays; any adds every kind, boats and campsites too. The long-stays persona defaults to any.

tags.description: Filter ids the hotel must score 8+ on, e.g. ['soundproofing', 'reliable_wifi']; their names work too ('quiet'). See get_filters.

max_price.description: Maximum indicative price per night in USD.

district.description: Neighbourhood to restrict to, e.g. 'Gothic Quarter'. get_city_overview lists the districts; another area name is matched against hotel addresses.

near_lat.description: Latitude of a landmark or address the user names (not the user's own location); with near_lng restricts results to hotels within radius_km and reports distance_km.

near_lng.description: Longitude of the point of interest.

radius_km.description: Search radius around near_lat/near_lng in km (default 3).

sort_by.description: best = Comfort Score (default); value = Comfort Score per $100; nearest needs near_lat/near_lng.

hotel_name.description: Find a hotel by name in this city (part of the name works, e.g. 'Pestana'), including hotels outside our rankings; the other filters are then ignored.

page.description: Page of results (default 1; up to 5) for 'show me more'.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.title: Hotel details
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one hotel: why it scores as it does, or whether it's quiet, clean or good for sleep or work. Returns the Comfort Score breakdown, what the scores rest on, the five must-haves, its strengths and complaints with the reason behind each score, price and its okstays.com link. Pass focus with what the user asked about; detail='full' adds every scored signal (about four times longer). Read-only, no sign-in.

focus.description: Signals the user asked about, as filter ids or names (e.g. ['quiet', 'bed', 'wifi']); always included with their reasons.

detail.description: summary (default) or full: every scored signal with its explanation, about four times longer.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.title: Covered destinations
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which destinations OKstays covers, or before planning a trip through a country. Returns every destination we score with its country, slug and number of hotels; pass country to list one country only. Read-only, no sign-in.

country.description: Country name to filter by, e.g. 'Spain'.

tools.name: get_filters
tools.title: Filters and travel styles
tools.description: Use this to look up the comfort signals and travel styles that search_hotels accepts, when the user's wish doesn't map clearly to one. Returns every filter (id, name, description, category, whether it's a must-have) and every travel style. Plain names also work in search_hotels tags ('quiet', 'wifi'). Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.title: Compare hotels
tools.description: Use this when the user is choosing between 2-4 specific hotels. Returns each hotel's Comfort Score breakdown, price, strengths and complaints, the signals where they differ most, and a verdict: best comfort, cheapest, best value. Hotel ids come from search_hotels (hotel_name finds a hotel the user names). Read-only, no sign-in.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: find_similar_hotels
tools.title: Find similar hotels
tools.description: Use this when the user likes a hotel but wants alternatives, e.g. 'like this one but cheaper' (cheaper_only). Returns hotels in the same destination with the closest comfort profile, none with repeated complaints about cleanliness, beds, showers, bugs or safety, with the price difference. Read-only, no sign-in.

hotel_id.description: Hotel id to find alternatives for.

cheaper_only.description: Only hotels priced below this one.

max_price.description: Maximum price per night in USD.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: get_city_overview
tools.title: Destination overview
tools.description: Use this when the user is still choosing a destination or an area to stay in. Returns how many hotels we score, the average Comfort Score, median price, where its hotels beat and trail the average hotel, the best neighbourhoods with their top hotel, and which travel styles it suits. A request for hotels (e.g. 'quiet hotels in Bangkok') is search_hotels' job. Read-only, no sign-in.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.title: Plan a multi-stop trip
tools.description: Use this when the user plans a trip with several stops. Returns hotels for each stay in travel order (e.g. Lisbon 4 nights, Porto 3, Madrid 5): the best match for each stop by the OKstays Comfort Score (or the travel style's score), alternatives, the stay dates and an indicative total. Each hotel link opens its OKstays page with the stop's dates, so its Book Now button books those nights. Agree the stops and nights with the user first; list_cities shows which destinations of a country we cover. Read-only, no sign-in.

location.description: City name or slug, as in search_hotels.

start_date.description: Check-in date of the first stop, YYYY-MM-DD; each stop starts when the one before ends. Without it, no dates are set.

persona.description: Travel style for every stop: digital-nomad, deep-sleep, avoid-crowds, romantic, family, business, solo-safe, luxury, budget-comfort, long-stays.

property_type.description: property_type: hotels (default), apartments, hostels or any. hotels includes guest houses, B&Bs, aparthotels and resorts; apartments includes holiday homes, villas and homestays; any adds every kind, boats and campsites too. The long-stays persona defaults to any.

tags.description: Filters every hotel must score 8+ on, as in search_hotels.

max_price.description: Maximum indicative price per night in USD.
